narrative:
Group GP per message is 6.8 øre. Norway earns 9.3 øre, the Nordics 8.6–9.3, Central and Western Europe 6.5–6.9 and International 2.8 øre because wholesale dominates it.

Growth is broad (+8.0% to +9.4% in the five European markets), so the gap to ambition is mix, not market. Open exception: Enterprise SMS Norway at 7.4 øre vs 6.5 expected.

signals.title: Wholesale: 40% of volume, 7% of GP
signals.source: SDP GP per message — 24.9bn messages, FY2026 forecast
signals.excerpt: Carrier Wholesale SMS earns 1.3 øre per message against 16.3 øre for conversational traffic. Every 1bn messages moved from wholesale to conversational adds about NOK 150M of GP at today's unit economics.

signals.title: FY2026 GP forecast NOK 30M short of the double-digit ambition
signals.source: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget (MyLINK CORE ambition)
signals.excerpt: Gross profit lands at NOK 1,690M (+8.2% on FY2025), NOK 30M (1.7%) below the NOK 1,720M ambition. Growth is broad across the five European markets; the gap is a mix issue, not a market issue.
